summary: Full backend + frontend testing completed for SMPN 37 Jakarta Nilai & Raport app. 17/17 pytest tests passed (auth, auth-protection on 4 endpoints, kelas/mapel/siswa/nilai data, nilai/bulk save+persistence, PDF student + kelas, Excel leger, 404 handling). Playwright e2e passed: auth redirect to /login, wrong credentials toast, valid login redirects to dashboard, kelas 7A shows wali kelas (Desima Silalahi, M.Pd.) + 36 siswa, mapel selection enables tabs, GradeGrid loads, cells persist after save+reload, color classes (>=75 green, <75 red) correct, Paste-from-Excel modal applies tab-separated row correctly, Input Manual save/next work, Raport per-student print/download trigger 200 application/pdf, Leger excel download returns 200 spreadsheetml.sheet.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~487-line file; still manageable but future growth (auth, routers, pdf, excel) should be split into modules (routes/, services/pdf.py, services/excel.py).
seed_data() only seeds when collection is empty; if seed_data.json changes (new mapel/kelas/siswa), DB won't be refreshed. Consider version-tagged seed or idempotent upsert.

CORS_ORIGINS default of '*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Harmless now (Bearer token in Authorization header, not cookie-based), but should be an explicit origin list in production.
Shared single credential stored in plaintext in .env (AUTH_PASSWORD) and compared with == — acceptable per product spec (shared teacher login) but no brute-force protection/rate-limit.
/api/nilai/bulk performs sequential awaits per item; for large classes consider bulk_write for performance.
No input validation that f1..s3 are within 0-100 on the backend (clamped only on the client). A malicious client could store any float.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. One nilai record (first siswa of 7A, Matematika) was overwritten during testing — benign, upsert semantics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows pass. backend_test.py covers 17 cases via pytest-xdist and completes in ~4s. Playwright confirms all data-testid selectors in Login, Dashboard, GradeGrid, ManualEntry, RaportSection, LegerSection. PDFs/Excel are fetched as blobs via axios with Bearer header — verified both via curl-style requests and via browser network tap.
